def get_paths(dataset_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    """Get list of all input paths for the dataset."""
    paths = []
    paths += [dataset_dir / "data.json"]
    paths += [dataset_dir / "metadata.json"]
    paths += [dataset_dir / "source"]
    paths += [dataset_dir / "patches"]
    paths += [dataset_dir / "testcases"]
    paths += [dataset_dir / "tests"]
    paths += [dataset_dir / "solutions"]

    for path in paths:
        if not path.exists():
            raise ValueError(f"The file {path} does not exist!")

    return paths


def load_data(paths: list[Path]) -> dict:
    """Load the data in all input files."""
    data = defaultdict(dict)
    for path in paths:
        if path.is_dir():
            # load_dataset()
            continue
        elif path.suffix == ".json":
            data[path.stem] = json.loads(read_file(path))
    return data


def load_dataset(paths: list[Path]) -> dict:

        if path.is_dir():
